node.title: Rank-eleven full-span residual forcing
node.closure: every unsafe rank-eleven survivor has full ten-dimensional collective nontransverse correction span
node.statement: At the official KoalaBear post-near rank-eleven interface, use tau=1679 and h=38384 in the anchored row-space router. The transverse envelope is 209812758437679617. If the collective nontransverse row-space span V_nt had dimension at most nine, ordinary affine-span plus sub-square two-fold interleaving would cap all nontransverse slopes by R_9=(n-A) floor(C(n-K+9,9)/C(A-K+9,9))=65157026870188671. Their total 274969785307868288 is below B_*=274980728111395087 by 10942803526799. Hence every unsafe line has dim(V_nt)>=10; since V_nt<=C' and dim(C')<=10, dim(V_nt)=dim(C')=10. Its nontransverse mass is at least 65167969673715471, forcing at least 262093370 represented row spaces and 16384884 distinct promoted rich containers with at least 38385 common actual zeros each. Adjacent h=38385 is over by 2062328934603. The globally best dimension-ten one-container formula remains over by 773076621594690156.
